data.body: Run intake-1ea674f2 failed checks on TS2322 in EmployerReviewSummary.tsx and then on aria-label text carrying literal <var> tags, because the portal i18n sets interpolation.alwaysFormat. Three repairs did not find interpolation: { alwaysFormat: false }, which PaginatedTable.tsx already uses, and the run parked on llm_calls_exceeded. Its commit e80a276 had parent 6b2f996 on base aa113d9 and the tree of base 9ea775e plus four ticket files, so it changed 1003 files. commit_and_push in adapters/real/git_host.py parents on the remote branch head with commit-tree, which became ADEVX-148. The pilot ticket gained the alwaysFormat guidance. The stale agent branch was deleted after a backup to refs/backup/agent-ff34-7786-fef6-4252-20261008. inv restart failed on the host twice, once on the system interpreter and once on localhost:5432, and ran inside the activity worker, which became ADEVX-150.
